beats.care: If you're a civil engineering grad, you may have to choose between a state and a central job exam unless TGPSC changes the date.
beats.what: On Saturday, job aspirants sat in protest outside the TGPSC office in Nampally, with police deployed, asking for the AEE exam to be moved.
beats.why: TGPSC's Roads and Buildings AEE (Civil) exam clashes with the SSC Junior Engineer exam, and many civil engineers wrote both.

cards.body: Protesters say they have gone to TGPSC for 10 days without a positive reply. BRS leaders Dasoju Sravan Kumar, RS Praveen Kumar and Manne Krishank have asked for new dates.
TGPSC recruits for Telangana government posts. SSC, the Staff Selection Commission, recruits for central government departments across India.
cards.title: tgpsc vs ssc: what's the difference?

cards.q: Who should move their exam date?
Will TGPSC reschedule the AEE exam before 6 Nov?

opts: It clashes with the SSC JE exam
cards.q: Why are aspirants upset about TGPSC's AEE exam date?
cards.why: Many civil engineers applied for both exams, and a same-day clash means missing one.

hook: Two govt job exams, *one day*. Which would you skip?

learn.t: Civil engineers can apply for both the state AEE and central SSC JE posts, so one shared date forces a choice.

tldr: Job aspirants protested at the TGPSC office because its AEE (Civil) exam is on the same day as the SSC Junior Engineer exam.
watch: Both exams are reported for 6 November. Watch whether TGPSC reschedules before then.
